query:
SELECT ct.id AS "contact_id?"
                    FROM crm_companies co
                    LEFT JOIN crm_contacts ct
                        ON ct.company_id = co.id AND (NOT ct.hidden OR $3)
                    WHERE co.id = $1
                      AND co.team_id = $2
                      AND (NOT co.hidden OR $3)
                    ORDER BY ct.id
